analysis:
Integration of units 38-71 found no concrete security regression in the supplied evidence. Main changes: (1) GLM-5.3-Flash forced tool_choice and JSON response_format are served through post-generation validation (GLM5NextPromptPolicy, ToolChoiceEnforcementPolicy, GLM5NextResponseFormat). Fixed error messages, 400 or 422 mapping, media refusal and a stricter ToolConstraintSchema (requireExplicitResponseTypes) only add rejections. (2) The weight-hash path changed: the managed GLM load's verifiedArtifactSHA256 replaces the pre- and post-load WeightHasher passes (StandaloneServer ~1964-2006, ProviderLoop+ModelLoading ~546-660, injectable loadWeightHasher), and a new VerifiedWeightHashStore (verified-weights.json, 0600, keyed on dev/inode/size/mtime/ctime) lets registration reuse a recorded hash (Darkbloom.swift ~171-229, StartCommand+Modes, Serve.swift:108). Relevant to T-012, T-027 and T-041 (weight-hash binding for the SSD cache). The registration hash is already self-reported and the operator is adversarial, and the load re-verifies per-file SHA-256, so no new bypass is evidenced. (3) PageCache.drop (mmap + msync) after hashing. (4) Memory admission now counts page cache as available, which is an availability concern only. (5) The GLM wired-limit advice is advisory and prints text only. (6) The firstWithheldOutputAt rename affects deadline and TTFT only.

Unverified contracts for further review, all outside the supplied source: GLM5NextManagedLoad and requireGLM5NextLoadedArtifact failing closed on nil or mismatched digests. VerifiedWeightHashStore internals and its consumer gating on weightsVerifiedByManagedLoad. GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report, which receives raw errors and modelID from decrypted-request-derived data; it must not log prompt-derived content (A-001). The default of loadWeightHasher, and the test seams in ProviderLoop+Testing.swift, which are not #if DEBUG-gated but are internal. The GLM post-load identity comparison now happens only in recordVerifiedGLM5NextWeightHash. The StandaloneServer head hunk was only partly visible. All 34 units were examined; the uncertainty is about unseen implementations rather than a demonstrated defect.
